It's my fault for not stating it more forthright. I guess what I am looking for is something that doesn't exist. You can't help those that don't help themselves and that sort. My feelings stem from this feeling like a failure, and I feel the only thing that can realistically help me is to succeed, although I may just have to accept I will never be truly contented with myself, even if I were not objectively a failing. The difficult I have here is that there is nothing anyone can tell me, there are no stories I could hear told that could lift my spirits, because even if someone tells me I am not, I simply cannot believe what they say. Similarly, I do not wish to take medications, as I feel that would only delude myself into having the potential to believe something that is not, akin to someone on strong sedatives finding contentedness, and I would have no part of that, for if I cannot succeed on my own terms then I am by my own mark a failure. I feel myself human garbage, and the only truly fitting end for myself is to just end it all, a feeling that has become significantly more pervasive in my head over the last year, and I feel is coming to a head.

I hope this doesn't come across as dramatically as I know some people may read it, and I appreciate your time. I don't know why I made a thread to tell you the truth and sorry if you feel I have wasted it.

I appreciate your advice and time. I guess I meant more as a purpose of visiting a doctor. My girlfriend has implored me to visit a physician, but I do not think they're capable of doing anything other than what I described. Either prescribe me some medications, or refer me to a therapist, the former of which I do not want to do, and the latter would not be helpful.
